19946:4335.name: Button
19946:4335.description:
Button: triggers an event or action and says what will happen next. Replaces Filled, Tonal, Outlined and Text buttons with one set.

appearance: default (outlined, border/bold) · primary (brand bold) · subtle (no ground until hover) · warning · danger · discovery (something new or proposed). One primary per view.
state: default · hover · press · focus (2px border/focused ring, 2 outside). spacing: default 32 · compact 24 (table rows and inline toolbars only).
isSelected, isDisabled and isLoading are drawn at state=default; isLoading keeps the width, hides the content and centers a Spinner.
iconBefore / iconAfter show a 16px Icon; set its glyph on the instance. ✏️ label is the text.

Tokens: color / foundations (background/<role>/bold/*, background/neutral/subtle/*, selected, disabled; text and icon from the same role) and spacing / foundations (Element/pad-x-md·sm, pad-y-md·sm, inline-md, radius-item-md·sm, Border/*). The focus ring takes Element/radius-item-md at both spacings.

Code: Button from @/components. The appearance, spacing, isSelected, iconBefore and iconAfter props are pending the Button refresh; today code takes style, size, fill, disabled and loading.

19595:49.name: Icon
19595:49.description:
Icon: one Font Awesome Free glyph in a square box exactly its size, with no padding inside.

name: the glyph, typed as its Font Awesome name. style: regular or solid (iconStyle in code); regular is the default where Font Awesome Free has one. brands is a separate family chosen by name; for brand marks use Icon / brand, which draws them as vectors. size: 12, 16 or 24, on Size/Icon/sm, md and lg (--icon-sm, --icon-md, --icon-lg). color: the glyph fill takes an icon color role variable. color/icon/default is the default role (--ds-icon); every other role is color/icon/<role> (--ds-icon-<role>). Swap the fill variable on the instance. label is code only: with it the icon is a named image; without it the icon is hidden and the words beside it carry the meaning.

20299:9069.name: Icon button
20299:9069.description:
Icon button: an icon-only button for a common, recognizable action where space is limited.

appearance: default (outlined) · subtle (no ground until hover) · primary (brand bold) · discovery (something new). No warning or danger.
state: default · hover · press · focus (2px border/focused ring, 2 outside). spacing: default 32 square · compact 24 square. shape: default (rounded square) · circle (top navigation only).
isSelected, isDisabled and isLoading are drawn at state=default; isLoading hides the icon and centers a Spinner.
icon is an exposed Icon instance (default fa-solid pen): set its glyph on the instance. label is the accessible name and tooltip text: it is not drawn in the button.

Code: IconButton, label required.
